metadata_checked: symlink target and target byte length
metadata_limits: Tar does not preserve inode, device, ctime, original directory st_size or original link counts; these remain in the hashed source inventory. Inventory contains stat metadata, not per-file hashes. All regular bytes were independently hashed; expected hashes are checked for source/binary manifests and compact copies, while whole-archive hashes bind all other content.
scope: Read-only offline archive data audit; tar members read in memory without extraction or execution
